title: Rider Fee Schedule Clause: Cleaning Fee Charged on Approval
content:
**Clause.** The fee charged when a Cleaning and Damage Fees cleaning fee report is approved is based on the flat fee of the level held and is held to a ceiling of 2.5 times that flat fee, rounded half up to the cent: it is the flat fee of the level held, never more than 2.5 times that flat fee. The fee charged on approval is the amount booked as the fee charge.

## Elements of the clause

| Element | Rule |
|---|---|
| Level | the cleaning level the assessment holds at approval |
| Amount | that level's flat fee, from the schedule of fees |
| Ceiling | 2.5 times the same flat fee |
| Rounding | half up to the cent, once, at the end |

## Worked figures (hypothetical levels)

- A level whose flat fee is $60.00: the ceiling is $60.00 multiplied by 2.5, that is $150.00; the fee charged is $60.00.
- A level whose flat fee is $100.00: the ceiling is $250.00; the fee charged is $100.00.

The figure booked on the fee charge entry and charged to the rider's card is the same figure.
